system.description:
You can speak to anyone you've had contact with using a discreet cipher, hand gesture, or message drop. Once you've opened a channel, they can reply the same way. Additionally, mark a Stress to make a Wits roll against them. On a success, ask the GM one:

  • What was their last known drop point or contact location?
  • What message or item did they recently pass or receive?
  • Who are they secretly working for or reporting to?
  • What operation or scheme are they currently involved in?
